title: 210K/h Obsidian Portal Farm --- White Mc
description:
Hi guys, this video is a small introduction for a new 210K/hour Obsidian Portal Farm

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This farm uses 12 withers to produce about 210K obsidian per hour, and 6 snowgolems to produce enough snowballs to damage the withers every 20 gt/second. This farm is a 1.21 farm.
